ADR-006: Framework-Agnostic Module Topology (ag-ui-core, ag-ui-a2a, ag-ui-langchain4j, ag-ui-quarkus) and Removal of Quarkus Deployment Processors

metadata.decision: 1. Drop all Quarkus -deployment modules and replace them with standard Jandex-indexed JARs containing META-INF/beans.xml and META-INF/native-image reflect-config.json. 2. Factor modules under ag-ui-bom into ag-ui-core (org.agui.core.*: domain payloads, formatters, Flow adapters, transport ports, session registry, SSE/WebSocket sessions, MCP bridge, token builders), ag-ui-a2a (org.agui.a2a.*: A2A SDK bridge), ag-ui-langchain4j (org.agui.langchain4j.*: pure upstream dev.langchain4j TokenStream and lifecycle event adapter), and ag-ui-quarkus (org.agui.quarkus.*: thin Quarkus adapter for Mutiny Multi, Quarkiverse Multi<ChatEvent>, and Quarkus WebSockets Next). 3. Keep jakarta.enterprise.cdi-api as provided scope across core and protocol modules so classes work with new in plain Java/Spring and @Inject in CDI/Quarkus.

label: ADR-007: Adopt Upstream AG-UI SDKs (com.ag-ui.community & @ag-ui/client) and Orthogonal Java 17 Quarkus Modules

metadata.decision: 1. Adopt upstream com.ag-ui.community:{java-core,java-server,java-client}:0.1.1 on Java 17 across 4 orthogonal library modules managed by ag-ui-bom: ag-ui-quarkus (RESTEasy Reactive SSE, Jackson MixIns for @ag-ui/core Zod compatibility, reusable AgUiWebSocketHandler, GraalVM reflect-config.json), ag-ui-langchain4j (TokenStream/Agent adapter, RFC 6902 AgUiStatePatch, HITL InterruptOutcome, Tri-Protocol rawEvent provenance), ag-ui-quarkus-langchain4j (Multi<ChatEvent> bridge), and ag-ui-a2a (A2A Task -> Step/ActivitySnapshot bridge). 2. Keep Java 25 + Virtual Threads + GraalVM 25 in examples/quarkus-svelte-skeleton. 3. Dual-license repository as Apache-2.0 OR MIT. 4. Build headless @agui/svelte over @ag-ui/client + @ag-ui/core (Wave 2) and delete ag-ui-core upon showcase cutover (Wave 3).

label: ADR-008: Canonical AG-UI ACTIVITY_SNAPSHOT Surface Kit, Complete Trip Dossier Report & local-quarkus-agui CI

metadata.decision: 1. Extend ag-ui-langchain4j (AgUiRunOptions, AgUiLangChain4jRunSession) and @agui/svelte to emit and reduce canonical ActivitySnapshotEvent (ACTIVITY_SNAPSHOT) envelopes alongside StateDeltaEvent. 2. Deliver a 5-card Svelte 5 AG-UI surface kit (AgUiWeatherCard, AgUiLocationMapCard with Google/Apple/OSM/Wikipedia links + toggleable OSM preview, AgUiSecurityAdvisoryCard, AgUiFxBudgetCard, AgUiCultureAudioCard) dispatched via AgUiActivityRenderer across both AssistantTurn chat streams and TripDossierPanel (+ Markdown export). 3. Auto-populate all 5 live MCP/A2A sections on complete trip runs while emitting focused single cards on single-topic queries. 4. Upgrade sdlc-quality-gate.yml to run the unified Dual-Gate pipeline on runs-on: local-quarkus-agui.
